items.title: [P0.1] Inventory existing drafts and validation evidence
items.acceptance: Current files, actual validations and gaps are documented without claiming deployment.

items.title: [P0.2] Prepare phased plan and current/target HLD
items.acceptance: Plan includes steps, owners, dependencies, estimates, gates and exits; HLD distinguishes drafts and target.

items.title: [P0.3] Validate event-driven tracker and update agreement
items.acceptance: Refresh produces status/remaining work; gates, failed and stale evidence are handled; tracker tests pass.

items.title: [P0.4] Review and accept plan/HLD or request amendments
items.acceptance: Explicit user acceptance recorded; implementation remains paused while pending.

items.title: [P1.1] Review existing draft code, dependencies and gaps
items.acceptance: Draft review records corrections, supported versions and treatment of the deprecation/incomplete CI input.

items.title: [P1.2] Validate API and retrieval contracts
items.acceptance: Schemas and examples validate; authentication, outcomes and bounds agree with intended behavior.

items.title: [P1.3] Complete synthetic policy workload and adapter
items.acceptance: Real HTTP tool path and versioned expected-answer dataset pass; mock usage is explicitly unknown.

items.title: [P1.4] Validate propagation and metadata-only telemetry
items.acceptance: Service/version identity, exact span graph, low-cardinality metrics and content-capture boundaries are tested.

items.title: [P1.5] Prove local backend runner and lifecycle
items.acceptance: Working chosen runner starts/stops owned services; backend readiness and ephemeral retention are documented.

items.title: [P1.6] Record complete local trace and exported-data evidence
items.acceptance: Fresh run saves machine-readable results, backend trace graph and canary checks against exported telemetry; bounded failure is demonstrated.

items.title: [P2.1] Confirm recommended repository destinations for javedkumail
items.acceptance: Exact personal owner, repository names, private visibility and plan constraints confirmed without sharing secrets.

items.title: [P2.2] Review source and push to four user-created public repositories
items.acceptance: Four exact private remotes verified; reviewed source pushed and commits recorded; GitLab credentials/remotes preserved.

items.title: [P2.3] Complete reproducible CI, contract tests and builds
items.acceptance: Required locks exist; clean-checkout CI and image build pass; immutable actions and restricted PR permissions verified.

items.title: [P2.4] Pin image digests and multi-repository release manifest
items.acceptance: Known commits/releases and immutable images reproduce the local demo; scoped coordination credentials are documented.

items.title: [P2.5] Create AI-SRE-Oberveability organization under personal ownership
items.acceptance: Requested exact organization exists on GitHub Free; javedkumail ownership verified; no GitLab credential changes.

items.title: [P2.6] Transfer four repositories and verify history, visibility and remotes
items.acceptance: Each repository ID and branch history is preserved under the requested organization; public visibility retained; local remotes and current source links updated.

items.title: [P2.7] Set up shared GitHub Project and map POC tasks
items.acceptance: One organization Project links the four repositories, contains the current task set with accurate statuses/dependencies, and has a documented after-step synchronization path.

items.title: [P3.1] Confirm personal Azure targets, region and budget
items.acceptance: Supplied exact tenant/subscription and personal identity are matched; region/budget/currency and model requirement recorded.

items.title: [P3.2] Produce costed Azure HLD and runner/network design
items.acceptance: Component active/idle costs, retention, AKS/runner reachability and optional Managed footprint are documented using dated inputs.

items.title: [P3.3] Prepare Terraform, state bootstrap and scoped OIDC
items.acceptance: IaC validates with provider locks; private state ownership, scoped RBAC/federation, actual OIDC subject and resource tags are verified.

items.title: [P3.4] Review concrete IaC plan and authorize spending scope
items.acceptance: Concrete plan, cost assumptions, resource scope and lifecycle presented and authorized once for the agreed bounds.

items.title: [P3.5] Deploy pinned Azure baseline through GitHub Actions
items.acceptance: Only authorized resources deploy; workflow, smoke, telemetry and cloud-mock release evidence saved.

items.title: [P3.6] Verify cloud start/stop and scoped destroy/recreate
items.acceptance: Owned lifecycle works for exact scope; remaining stopped-resource costs/state and evidence retention documented.

items.title: [P4.1] Confirm Managed entitlement and supported configuration
items.acceptance: Licence/installer, cluster/agent compatibility, vendor sizing/OS/storage, connectivity, retention and cost envelope confirmed.

items.title: [P4.2] Provision and configure supported Managed backend
items.acceptance: Licensed backend on supported dedicated hosts is installed/configured through documented reproducible steps.

items.title: [P4.3] Validate native and selected custom instrumentation
items.acceptance: Separate native/custom cohorts validate endpoints, auth, enrichment, retention and duplicate spans for each signal.

items.title: [P4.4] Build supported views and tested compatibility matrix
items.acceptance: Supported dashboards/alerts/read APIs and exact versions recorded; reference enterprise environment gaps and SaaS-only features explicitly labelled.

items.title: [P5.1] Define synthetic status tools and incident fixtures
items.acceptance: Allowlisted health/version/failure schemas and versioned synthetic incidents have expected outcomes.

items.title: [P5.2] Implement bounded service-status investigation agent
items.acceptance: Retries/steps/tools/time bounds and injected failure cases pass; token bounds are verified only when live provider is authorized.

items.title: [P5.3] Implement profile-specific read-only monitoring adapter
items.acceptance: Bounded local evidence reads pass; live Managed adapter additionally requires P4.4 evidence; unrestricted queries/writes are absent.

items.title: [P5.4] Validate evidence-citing read-only SRE copilot
items.acceptance: Timeline, causes, evidence IDs, uncertainty and human checks pass versioned incident tests; untrusted text cannot add write/shell tools.

items.title: [P6.1] Define comparison cohorts and acceptance measurements
items.acceptance: Matched load, expected graphs, baselines, versions and measurement scripts defined before experiments.

items.title: [P6.2] Run coverage, overhead, outage, redaction and rollout experiments
items.acceptance: 100-request coverage, duplication/loss, p95 overhead, outage recovery and zero-prohibited-value results recorded with limitations.

items.title: [P6.3] Run authorized live-model evidence and optional triage replays
items.acceptance: Real provider timing/available usage, dated pricing and model bounds recorded; optional three-replay triage evidence labelled exploratory.

items.title: [P6.4] Rebuild from releases and prepare demonstration/report
items.acceptance: Pinned checkout reproduces demo; presentation/report state costs, compatibility, measured outcomes and outstanding limitations.

items.title: [P6.5] Complete scoped cleanup and evidence handover
items.acceptance: Reviewed dedicated-scope teardown verified, remaining resources inventoried and sanitized evidence/lifecycle instructions handed over.
